selection: All 44 perspective decisions with an actual active Quick Claw holder and both sides having multiple legal choices; first 12 no-observable-claw controls by the frozen state-hash order. All states replayed from the 24-game corpus.
arm_order: Alternate by case index plus repetition. One baseline warm-up of 1000 iterations per case.
timed_budget: Per-case median baseline construction-plus-27000-step wall time, equally assigned to both arms.
time_control: Sequential measured searches; no other task-owned benchmarks or test jobs launched during measurement. Shared-host native timings, not device CPU time.

next_stage_screen.meaning: A feasibility screen for a full-game regression experiment, not an adoption criterion or evidence of stronger play.
